notes.body: Gmail confirms Amy sent a full Adventure Zone introduction to info@allpointstransit.org on March 17, 2026 with subject 'Montrose Oktoberfest (Montrose, CO) - Sept 26, 2026.' No reply is present in that thread. Current official All Points Transit Oktoberfest page still displays the 2025 event rather than a 2026 announcement. The prior event format used the Montrose Rotary Amphitheater at Cerise Park, offered kids 12 and under free admission and kids activities, so this is not automatically a non-fit despite the craft-beer focus. Before any new message, verify the official 2026 date/status. If confirmed, write a short history-aware follow-up, not another introduction.
